description: E180. `reasons`: why a reference-case declaration, a run start or a read was refused, one closed key each, one sentence each; nothing was stored (the HTTP status of each is the service's `reference_cases.STATUS`). `lines`: the words a person reads beside a tool version's reference cases and runs. Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code. Frozen in slice 0; slices 1 and 2 raise them.

reasons.no-verdict: No one has accepted this version; only accepted work can be a reference case.
reasons.rejected: The verdict named rejects this version; only accepted work can be a reference case.
reasons.verdict-not-current: The verdict named is not its author's current verdict on this version.
reasons.verdict-other-version: The verdict named is on another version.
reasons.verdict-by-agent: A reference case rests on a person's acceptance, not an assistant's.
reasons.made-by-tool: Made by this tool: a result the tool under test produced cannot be its reference.
reasons.accepted-as-input: A case cannot give the tool the accepted result, or another version of it, as an input.
reasons.unreadable: You cannot open every version this case names.
reasons.set-unknown: No reference cases for this tool in this project.
reasons.run-unknown: No reference run Ophiolite made in this project has this id.
reasons.set-moved: The reference cases changed since you read them; read them again.

lines.not-run: Reference cases not run for this version
lines.versions-run: Run on {count} versions of this tool
